来源: 2023年高考英语试卷（上海）（秋考）（解析卷）文末听力原文 + 原声逐词识别

念题.18: What can be learned about Mary?
念题.19: Why does Jane choose not to talk to Mary about her thoughts?
念题.20: What does the man suggest Jane do?

依据.18: She forgets to close the fridge door ... she never cares to take the garbage out or fetch the mails.
依据.19: Are you afraid you will offend her ...? Yeah, perhaps. I still want to be friends with her.
依据.20: Better to get things out in the open ... If you don’t talk to her about how you feel, you could end up going your separate ways.

干扰项复核: A/B/D、A/B/C、A/B/D 均与原文不符；正确项各恰好一个。
